name: School Orientation
summary:
"School Orientation" is a VR application designed to support middle school students during the transition to high school.

Through an experiential journey, the app helps reveal personal talents and natural inclinations through various activities:

Practical Lab Activities: Test your technical and manual skills with hands-on challenges and simulations.

Aptitude Tests: Discover your strengths with activities designed to identify the fields where you excel.
